title: Luxury Bath Product Material Configurator
description: A premium product configurator where users customize a luxury bath accessory display. The ShaderBall serves as a live material preview sphere sitting on a pedestal beside the bath_day scene, allowing users to cycle through surface finishes and adjust environment lighting to visualize how different materials look in a bathroom context.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that implements a luxury bath product material configurator. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader: place bath_day model on the right side of the scene as the environment context piece, and ShaderBall on the left side elevated on a subtle circular platform as the material preview object. Scale and position both models so they are visually balanced and fully visible. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at a 3/4 angle looking at the center point between both models. Add OrbitControls with damping enabled, constrained to prevent going below the floor plane. Lighting should include a warm-toned DirectionalLight as key light, a cool-toned fill light, soft AmbientLight, and an optional HDR environment map using PMREMGenerator for reflections. Implement these interactions: (1) A floating HTML panel with 4 material preset buttons labeled Marble, Brushed Gold, Matte Ceramic, and Glossy Obsidian. Clicking each button smoothly transitions the ShaderBall material properties including color, metalness, roughness, and clearcoat over 0.5 seconds using requestAnimationFrame interpolation. (2) A slider labeled Lighting Warmth that shifts the key light color temperature from cool blue-white to warm amber, affecting how both models appear. (3) A toggle button labeled Spotlight Focus that activates a SpotLight with visible cone aimed at the ShaderBall, casting shadows onto the bath scene to demonstrate shadow interaction between the two assets. (4) Clicking directly on the ShaderBall via raycasting triggers a slow 360-degree auto-rotation of just that model to showcase the current material from all angles, clicking again stops it. Use a clean dark background with subtle gradient. Style the UI panel with semi-transparent dark glass-morphism aesthetic positioned at the bottom of the screen. Ensure shadows are enabled on the renderer with PCFSoftShadowMap.
